name: zkUSD Dollar
oneLiner: zkUSD is an issuer-controlled ZKsync token minted through Goal3's verified portal; current reserve, redemption, and peg-maintenance evidence is unavailable.
collateral: Reserve assets, counterparties, and custody arrangements are not established by a current primary source; the deployed zkUSD token contract does not by itself prove collateralization.
pegMechanism: Verified portal code accepts owner-configured stable tokens, transfers deposits to a treasury, and mints a configured return token through a vesting flow. That code establishes an issuer-controlled deposit-and-mint path, but not 1:1 USDC redemption, current reserve coverage, or a peg-maintenance mechanism.

notices.title: Current reserve and redemption evidence unavailable
